annotation_description_on_image: red-outlined inset (higher magnification of euchromatin photoactivated area)
green/cyan-outlined inset (higher magnification of heterochromatin photoactivated area)
from_the_caption: Images are selected frames of PA time lapse with the photoactivated region represented by circles in euchromatin (red) or in heterochromatin (green) on the pre‐activation image.
The inserts outlined in red and green correspond to two higher magnifications of photoactivated areas in euchromatin and heterochromatin, respectively.
